Peregrine Pass.name: Peregrine Pass
Peregrine Pass.description: The user's signature move: they climb out of sight, fold their wings and drop faster than any car, then snap them open at street level and tear down a whole street in one pass. Every enemy along it takes massive slashing damage and is thrown off their feet, and the wind of the pass shatters windows; afterward the user's wings are spent and they cannot fly until the end of their next turn. Strain: severe.
